verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt at docs.snowflake.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured Snowflake Documentation index. Snowflake also publishes section-scoped llms.txt files for Snowpark, Streamlit and Snowflake Postgres, which gives agents targeted entry points. Missing for 10: no independent or community report of agents using these files in practice, and no evidence of a full-content (llms-full.txt) or per-page markdown variant.
